properties.title: Cuba (Havana José Martí MUHA): YELLOW 72h weather window — low cloud cover unlikely (22%) on 2026-11-27; tonight 0.2 h low-light dark
properties.summary: Across 51 ensemble members, low cloud cover at Havana José Martí (MUHA) is unlikely (20-45%) to reach the amber threshold (80.0 %) on 2026-11-27 UTC (72-hour stoplight: Yellow). Tonight's lunar illumination is 96% with 0.2 hours of nautical darkness under low moon. By model: ECMWF 11 of 51.

raise_by: a second independent line of evidence (have 1)
a scored Verdict record for this method version

alternatives.hypothesis: Weather remains below the operational threshold or passes in brief (< 3 h) local showers
alternatives.tell_apart: Subsequent 00Z/12Z ensemble runs drop below 20% member agreement or METAR at MUHA stays under 80.0 %

alternatives.hypothesis: Single-model bias between NOAA GEFS and ECMWF IFS inflates the tail probability
alternatives.tell_apart: Spread between GEFS (31) and ECMWF (51) member fractions exceeds 35 percentage points

resolution.rule: Yes if METARs from MUHA (Havana José Martí) report broken or overcast (BKN or OVC) cloud below 10,000 ft for >= 1 hours on 2026-11-27 UTC.
resolution.source: NOAA Aviation Weather Center METAR / SYNOP archive for MUHA (https://aviationweather.gov/data/metar/?ids=MUHA)
